finding: In-process execution is a technically established approach; compatibility with the user's current game is unverified.
candidate: Independent agent uses Android Activity.dispatchTouchEvent inside the selected game process. It does not invoke native gameplay functions or inject OS-wide touch events.
entry_requirement: An authorized instrumentation entry point such as an already-rooted device with Frida; installing an ordinary separate APK does not grant this access.

sources.supports: Android instrumentation requires a suitable entry point; root or embedding are documented options.
Activity API for delivering touch events to the activity window.
Separate Android apps are isolated by UID and sandbox.
Author describes an in-process agent for Brawl Stars 68.250 arm64; not independently tested here.
Reviewed only; its no-redistribution code was not copied into Iris.
Alternative separate display control; does not establish in-process game control.

not_done: No user device rooted or modified

input_fixes: Discard callbacks belonging to a canceled stroke even after a new stroke starts
